title: Album Cover Similarity Analysis
text:
Every album cover is compared across two visual dimensions:

Color Palette: Compares dominant RGB hues, saturation (vibrancy), and color tone.
Design & Composition: Compares overall brightness balance and grayscale visual contrast.

Scores range from 0% (completely opposite visual styles) to 100% (virtually identical color & layout).
